title: Wilted Kenyan Vegetables Stir-Fry
description: A quick and flavorful vegetarian-friendly Kenyan-inspired dish featuring steamed vegetables and a hint of Grand Marnier. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the mixed vegetables and cook for 5 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the garlic, ginger, and onion to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Steam the vegetables in a steamer basket for 2 minutes, or until tender.
Return the vegetables to the skillet and stir in the Grand Marnier, salt, and black pepper.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, or until the vegetables are coated with the sauce.
Stir in the fresh parsley and lemon juice.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Transfer any leftover vegetables to an airtight container and refrigerate for up to 3 days.
Reheat in the microwave or on the stovetop before serving.
Use leftover vegetables in a salad or as a side dish.
Consider serving with naan or rice for a filling meal.
Try substituting the Grand Marnier with another citrus-flavored liqueur for a different twist.
Experiment with different types of vegetables to find your favorite combination.
